run_default_argument_parser: run the default_argument_parser to parse command-line arguments for ShapeNet training
build_config_file_parser: build a parser that accepts a config file path via the --config-file argument
test_resume_checkpoint: test the resume flag to attempt resuming training from a checkpoint directory
create_eval_only_mode: create an evaluation-only run by passing the --eval-only flag to the parser
review_multi_gpu_setup: review the parser arguments for configuring multi-GPU training with --num-gpus and --num-machines
